_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id}, magpapat {num_rounds} rounds na Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Wala'y $ {pool} aro tan pisi'y sakey tan sakey Player {other_id}.

Mangiproposa:
  - Gumawa'y sakey offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - No tinanggap → Sikay makarekta $(pool - X), sakey player makarekta $X
  - No tinolak → Duway makarekta $0
  - Halimbawa: [Offer: $3]  o  'Kapigsa'y sakey ini. [Offer: $5]'

Mangiresponde:
  - Gumawa'y desisyon ed sakey offer na [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Halimbawa: 'Say sakey makatuor. [Accept]'
            'Napakaunfair. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Say round {round_number} et natan! ---
Managay {proposer_id} so proposer, Managay {responder_id} so responder.
round.offer: Say round {round_number}: Managay {proposer_id} mangi-offer ${offer} ed Managay {responder_id} (agtago ${keep}).
round.accepted: Inawat na Managay {responder_id}! Say round {round_number} ganansia: Managay {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Managay {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Say baleg ya total: Managay 0: ${total_0}, Managay 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Inibak na Managay {responder_id} so offer! Say round {round_number} ganansia: Saray duwa ya managay +$0. Say total et nanatili: Managay 0: ${total_0}, Managay 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Say proponent so nepeg ya mangiter na offer diad panamegley na format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Say kantidad ya in-offer et nepeg a balido.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Say offer diad dapat entre $0 tan ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Anggapoy aktual ya inyapay a naebatan.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Say responder diad aket ya [Accept] o [Reject] so offer.

outcome.win: Nanalo si Managay {winner} ed ${winner_total} total kontra Managay {loser} ya ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Tabla! Duway player tinapos na may ${total} total.
